scope: Separate UCR comparability assessment of corrected, complete external curricula; first-stage history remains immutable.

batches.selection_basis: First five ucr-assessment-pending targets in normalized production order.

prior_exception.reason: The external Mathematics pathway is now verified at 180 EC under the current ordinary OER. The previous UCR no-match judgment was based partly on a superseded 48-EC line and an unsupported additional 12-EC mathematics requirement. Its independent reassessment is a separate stage; no updated no-match judgment or UCR comparison is asserted here.
prior_exception.curriculumContext: Current selected Wiskunde line: first year 54 required + 6 free; later 24 common + 36 line + 48 free + 12 thesis. Three specified line courses and three restricted choices preserve the mathematical core. The original exception and UCR evidence are preserved in the remediation register as historical assessment, not reused as an assessment of the corrected pathway.

cases.academic_assessment: Two defensible complete UCR programmes were constructed independently of the former no-match judgment. The corrected 54-EC total open profile supports a broader response without changing the selected external Wiskunde line. All specialist pure-mathematics gaps remain explicit; medical modelling, physics/astronomy and mathematics-teaching candidates were assessed separately and not used as filler. Each included course has a specific content-based trace; the alternatives differ by five courses / 37.5 EC.

prior_exception.reason: The adopted Compas OER now verifies a complete 180-EC Fall 2026 external pathway, including minor 24 EC and thesis 6 EC. The earlier claim that these weights could not be verified is closed. A separate UCR assessment must decide the comparison outcome against this corrected external basis; the prior clinical no-match observations are historical evidence, not a newly completed assessment.
prior_exception.curriculumContext: Fall 2026 outgoing VUmc-compas: 60+60+60 EC. Amsterdam Global Health is a neutral minor selection; embedded practice and research are not double-counted. Current transition rules preserve this cohort sequence through the final full B3 teaching year 2028–2029. The prior unresolved exception and its UCR course evidence are preserved in the remediation register.

cases.academic_assessment: Two complete related-fields UCR programmes pass the academic and mechanical gates: biomedicine/neuroscience/health psychology and biomedicine/population health/social inclusion. The assessment uses the verified Fall 2026 Compas curriculum, not the incoming VUMED360 curriculum. Clinical training is explicitly unmatched; a lack of physician qualification alone was not used to reject the substantial biomedical and psychological response. Four course changes / 30 EC implement the social-inclusion alternative. The former clinical no-match observations remain historical, not the decision rule.

cases.academic_assessment: Three complete UCR programmes support historical culture/public memory, migration/political conflict and global political economy. All contain the six available UCR History courses and substantial advanced study. Related disciplines implement explicit target directions; course-level traces distinguish historical content from present-day applications. Geographic, period, Holocaust/genocide and digital-history gaps remain visible. The selected Dutch Algemeen route and all 180 EC were retained; its route-rule token was normalized to the approved least-specialized-general vocabulary without changing the choice.
